title: Be Part of India’s Biggest Cinema Celebration: Media Accreditation for 57th IFFI Closes on 15th October
body_text:
The last date for media accreditation for the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) 2026 is 15th October 2026 . Media professionals planning to cover the festival are advised to complete their registration through the official Press Information Bureau (PIB) accreditation portal before the deadline.
The festival will be held in Panaji, Goa, from 20th to 28th November 2026 , bringing together filmmakers, cinema professionals and film enthusiasts from India and across the world.
Media persons can register as Media Delegates through the official accreditation portal:
Registration Link: https://accreditation.pib.gov.in/eventregistration/login.aspx
Applicants are advised to carefully read the accreditation guidelines and ensure that all required documents are submitted along with their applications.
Required Documents:
Photograph Government identity proof PIB or State Government accreditation card, or organisation ID along with an Editor’s Letter Proof of work in the relevant field
Detailed eligibility criteria and media accreditation policy can be read here .
Media professionals already registered on the portal for the previous edition of IFFI can use their existing credentials to log in and update their documents, as required.
For queries related to media accreditation, applicants may contact iffi.mediadesk@pib.gov.in .
film enthusiasts who are not media persons may also register for IFFI as Delegates vide https://www.iffigoa.org/delegate-registration and enjoy the rich tapestry of films and other activities on offer at 57th IFFI 2026.
About IFFI
Born in 1952, the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) is South Asia’s oldest and largest celebration of cinema. Jointly hosted by the National Film Development Corporation (NFDC), Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India and the Entertainment Society of Goa (ESG), State Government of Goa, IFFI brings together filmmakers, legends and emerging voices from across the world. With international competitions, cultural showcases, masterclasses and tributes, the festival celebrates diverse stories, languages and cinematic traditions against the vibrant backdrop of Goa. For more information and latest details about the 57 th IFFI 2026 please visit https://www.iffigoa.org/ .
